about: Every test the release gate (tools/verify-test-gate.js) may see marked todo, BY IDENTITY. The gate fails if the run's todo set differs from this list in either direction, if an authorized todo starts passing, or if any other test is skipped. Added in S4 task 2b.2g (S4-PA-07). The gate must never learn this list from the run it polices: edit it by hand, in the same commit as the change that justifies it.

kinds.revival-contract: An assertion against a module excluded under decision register P19. It MUST stay todo while the module is excluded; if the module is reintroduced, the test must pass as an ordinary test and its entry leaves this file in that commit.
kinds.carried-residual: A reproduced defect carried to a named owner. It MUST LEAVE todo when repaired: remove the todo marker and this entry in the repair's commit.
